IPC Section: 115
Typical Evidence: Call detail records (CDRs) and transcripts of phone conversations, CCTV footage showing conspirators meeting, Written communication, emails, or messages planning the crime, Testimony of co-conspirators or approvers, Financial transactions or money trail indicating hiring or instigation
Evidence Categories: Digital Evidence, Documentary Evidence, Oral Testimony, Circumstantial Evidence

Evidence Categories: Documentary Evidence, Forensic Evidence, Oral Evidence

payload.page_content:
Crime Type: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night in order to commit offence punishable with imprisonment
IPC Section: 457
Typical Evidence: Tool marks or broken locks at the entry point, CCTV footage of the premises during the night, Fingerprints and shoe prints at the scene, Stolen property or items recovered from the accused, Eyewitness testimony of neighbors or security guards, Forensic reports matching DNA or fibers
Evidence Categories: Physical Evidence, Digital Evidence, Forensic Evidence, Testimonial Evidence, Documentary Evidence
